item.tib: ma mo stag ri rong gi bsad pa las kyi mchong
item.coloph: dang po gshen rab ston pas mdzad/ de ni stong rgyung mthu chen la gtad/ hris pa gyer med brnag pa la/ de nas dran pa bdag nyid la gtad/ bla chen dran pa bdag gis kyang / mi rul gur gum chus byug ste/ phyi rabs don du gter du sbas/ dus mtha'i 'gro don byed par shog u ya/ ag tham/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya/ (?) dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis mnyes/ de nas rim gyis stag btsun stag la rgyal mtshan/ des nam mkha' dbang rgyal/ dran pa lhun grub/ des tre ston tshun tshogs grags pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i (mas) bdag la'o//
